elen (People Ops): Heads up managers — condensed checklist + updated deadlines for this performance cycle. Please confirm you've read and completed the items by the due date. :spiral_calendar:

elen (People Ops): Critical dates: `Peer feedback due: 2026-03-31`, `Manager review form due: 2026-04-10 23:59 PDT`, `Calibration meetings: 2026-04-13 -> 2026-04-17`, `Ratings locked: 2026-04-24`. If you foresee delays follow the extension process below.

elen (People Ops): Manager quickflow (do in order):
A) Verify direct reports in Lattice -> People > My team
B) Skim goal updates + 1:1 notes (past 6 months)
C) Fill out manager section in the review form with recommended rating (`https://intranet.redwood/hr/review-form`)
D) Add 1-2 short calibration notes for edge cases using the mini-template (below)
E) Submit, then accept the calibration group invite (10-20m slots will be auto-booked)

elen (People Ops): Calibration note mini-template (paste into the field):
```
Context: [team changes, role shift]
Impact evidence: [metrics, customer feedback, deliverables]
Rating rationale: [concrete examples]
Follow-ups: [coaching or stretch goals]
```

sam (Eng Manager): Quick Q: my manager is OOO 04/08-04/12. Can I get an extension for a subset of my reports? :thinking:

maya (People Ops): We can approve short, manager-level extensions up to 48 hours for excused absences (medical/PTO/overlap). For >48 hours or where director sign-off is required, escalate to People Ops via the extension request form: `https://intranet.redwood/hr/extension-request` and cc your manager. We'll triage and confirm.

sam (Eng Manager): Filing now. Thanks! :+1:

jamal (Director, Eng): Do we have explicit calibration definitions for "Exceeds / Meets / Below"? Teams are using different language.

elen (People Ops): Short rubric to use in calibration:
- Exceeds Expectations: Consistently produces outsized impact for level; measurable results and ownership beyond scope.
- Meets Expectations: Reliable delivery of commitments, solid collaboration, no sustained gaps.
- Below Expectations: Repeated missed commitments or skill shortfalls that materially affect outcomes.

elen (People Ops): During calibration emphasize concrete impact (metrics, shipped features, customer notes). If a rating is contentious, add a 2-3 sentence note with links to artifacts (PRs, tickets, customer threads).

luca (Recruiter): Operational question: if a hiring freeze or comp hold overlaps calibration, should managers annotate open offers in notes?

maya (People Ops): Flag any hiring/comp implications in the calibration notes and ping me @maya. People Ops + Finance will coordinate; keep compensation conversations separate from individual performance narratives.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Manager review due in 7 days" will DM each manager on 2026-04-03 09:00 PDT.

elen (People Ops): Final ask: paste the mini-template into every manager note, attach supporting links, and RSVP to your calibration slot. If you hit form issues or missing directs, reply here or DM @maya. :eyes: 

sam (Eng Manager): Acknowledge — will complete before deadline. :white_check_mark:
